name: Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina)
description: A light-blue field charged at the centre with the shield of Sarajevo: green roof-shaped hills above a white wall with a gate and a valley crossed by a bridged river.
history: Adopted by decision of the City Assembly on 21 November 2000, replacing a provisional decision of 28 March 1998; light blue in proportions 1:2 with the city arms.

features.role: arms of Sarajevo with hills, gate and bridged river
features.symbolism: the mountains around the city, its old walls and the Miljacka
